subject: English
question_text: Fill in each gap with a suitable word of your own based on the information in the text. 0.
stimulus: At that time (a) — was an (b) — and dutiful (c) — officer. There were (d) — government (e) — to check the (f) — trade. But many (g) — them were (h) — . They are told to (i) nothing and not to (j) — anything.
